title: JopeDime multiclass classification fitness v1
description: Strict K-class (K >= 3) objectives on calibrated probability vectors. logloss, brier and cost_matrix_loss minimize; macro_f1, accuracy and balanced_accuracy maximize. Runtime bounds spec JSON to 32 KiB, refuses duplicate keys, and enforces input alignment, class membership/order and probability sums.

metric.description: logloss: -ln(p_true) without clipping; brier: sum_k (p_k - I[y=k])^2; both support mean/sum row aggregation. macro_f1, accuracy and balanced_accuracy use deterministic argmax along class_order (ties broken toward the earlier class in class_order) and require mean aggregation. cost_matrix_loss minimizes Bayes expected cost or argmax decision cost under a supplied K x K non-negative matrix.

aggregation.description: For logloss and brier: unweighted arithmetic mean or sum of row losses over all supplied held-out rows. Dataset-level metrics require mean aggregation.

undefined.description: Invalid inputs, undefined/non-finite losses or predictions return FITNESS_UNDEFINED for this candidate only.

cost_matrix.description: Required only for cost_matrix_loss. K x K matrix with rows=actual class in class_order and columns=predicted class in class_order; entries must be finite and non-negative.

class_order.description: At least three distinct exact class names in probability-column order.
